# MONTREAL.AI

MONTREAL.AI is the permanent founder-controlled parent institution of GoalOS, AGI.eth, AGI Club, AGI Alpha and a federation of project-specific intelligence Maisons.

Canonical public entry points:
- English: https://montrealai.github.io/
- Français: https://montrealai.github.io/fr/
- Public repository: https://github.com/MontrealAI/MontrealAI.github.io

Core doctrine:
- AI creates candidate output; GoalOS creates proof-governed missions.
- Execute, Validate, Accept, Admit and Settle are distinct acts.
- Public proof; private capability; governed authority.
- No model response, cryptographic commitment or browser demonstration independently proves an off-chain fact.
- Only validated, scoped, rights-cleared and revocable capability may enter institutional memory.

Claims boundary:
The public site does not claim achieved AGI or ASI, guaranteed returns, legal certification, external validation, customer acceptance or realized outcomes unless a specific public record supports that claim.
